svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="Sw4kFvD6mEyxqiKuFWIu"> <mxGraphModel dx="3552" dy="1938" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart LR
 User[\"Student, employee, or admin\"]
 Browser[\"Web browser\"]

 subgraph Frontend[\"React application (Vite)\"]
 Auth[\"Sign-in / registration\"]
 AuthCheck{\"Credentials match?\"}
 Workspace[\"Authenticated workspace<br/>(in-memory user state)\"]
 Enquiries[\"Enquiry / student management\"]
 Admissions[\"Admissions\"]
 Payments[\"Payment entry and review\"]
 Faculty[\"Faculty schedules\"]
 Dashboards[\"Admissions / payments dashboard\"]
 Analytics[\"Faculty analytics\"]
 StaticEnrollment[\"Enrollment analysis<br/>(static import)\"]

 Auth --> AuthCheck
 AuthCheck -->|Yes| Workspace
 AuthCheck -->|No| Auth
 Workspace --> Enquiries
 Workspace --> Admissions
 Workspace --> Payments
 Workspace --> Faculty
 Workspace --> Dashboards
 Workspace --> Analytics
 Workspace --> StaticEnrollment
 end

 subgraph Backend[\"Node.js HTTP API (server.js, port 3001)\"]
 API[\"JSON over HTTP<br/>/api/* routes\"]
 Validate[\"Route handling and<br/>selected field validation\"]
 end

 subgraph Persistence[\"Local JSON files (src/data)\"]
 Users[(\"authUsers.json\")]
 Students[(\"studentDetails.json\")]
 AdmissionData[(\"admissions.json\")]
 PaymentData[(\"studentPayments.json\")]
 BatchData[(\"batches.json\")]
 AvailabilityData[(\"facultyAvailability.json\")]
 end

 User --> Browser
 Browser --> Auth
 Auth -->|GET /users: fetch user list| API
 Auth -->|POST /users: register| API
 Validate -->|Read / write users| Users
 Users -->|User list| Auth

 Enquiries -->|GET /students| API
 Enquiries -->|POST /students, PUT /students/:id,<br/>DELETE /students/:id| API
 Admissions -->|GET /admissions, POST /admissions| API
 Payments -->|GET /payments, POST /payments| API
 Dashboards -->|GET /admissions| API
 Dashboards -->|GET /payments (admin view)| API
 Faculty -->|GET /batches, POST /batches| API
 Faculty -->|GET /faculty-availability,<br/>POST /faculty-availability| API
 Analytics -->|GET /batches| API
 Analytics -->|GET /faculty-availability| API

 API --> Validate
 Validate -->|Read / write enquiries| Students
 Validate -->|Read / write admissions| AdmissionData
 Validate -->|Read / write payments| PaymentData
 Validate -->|Read / write batches| BatchData
 Validate -->|Read / write availability| AvailabilityData
 AdmissionData -->|Admission records| Admissions
 AdmissionData -->|Admission and payment data| Dashboards
 API -->|Payments enriched from admissions / enquiries| Dashboards
 PaymentData -->|Payment records| Payments
 BatchData -->|Batch records| Faculty
 BatchData -->|Batch records for status / course analysis| Analytics
 AvailabilityData -->|Availability records| Faculty
 AvailabilityData -->|Availability for weekday / hours analysis| Analytics
 Students -->|Local static import| StaticEnrollment

 classDef limitation fill:#fff3cd,stroke:#b8860b,color:#333;
 AuthCheck:::limitation
 StaticEnrollment:::limitation
